content: Yesu nu Mosera witai.
Gera otao mamai naso, nikare dai utura gegenai, are nakai kotumai poti Yesura nana niro ge nuso sanekai. Nu ami ge ziro tata-tata inowenakai amira aposolo ata pris bamu wero nowia.
Mose meni Anutura sora noise sai dimaira ge te dipinoise noisonua.
So wai emara zazo bowire meni sora zazo bowire dainitinowia, da ago ine Yesura zazo bowire meni Mosera zazo bowire dainitinowia.
So dapikarago awa mamere. Ota Anutu nu nena dapikarago amira mama.
Mose nu Anutura sora noise bua sai dimaire inoisonua. Ago inoise ge ama kei awamu inoinua, ge awa ge me awa ganisekai sero gita toie soumai ine noisonua.

Ata Kristo meni awa nu soumai kota, nu Mamera Mai me noise Anutura so dia inoise nowia. So nuso nakai awa. Are awa tepo oko aewa. Nena namorekai seronai awa kei awaise sero ziro tata-tata inoise zewai wero nuamunonakai, awa dubu nuso wamunonakai.
Isreli ema Anutu doro deto-deto wewa ago ine oko wanekai.
Are Ozana meni ge ego senua awa ninanekai, Gita Anutu meni ware ena Isreli ema gaero gamu wenu deto-deto wewa. Are Anutu meni zeme ge nimorekare samunoya, awa deto-deto ago ine oko wawe.
Ewowo-kawowo nisokare nukare ware ena na gaero gamu wasara tani koko inoe dona zepa 40 ago tepo wenua.
Nukare na gaero gamu wewa gina waya wenu tini kapenu giro numorekare ego sena awa, “Nukare duba nusokare be giti sisinoise nowera awa. Nukare ebata naso zo da di oko giro baitiwa.”
Na ago amira tini kapenu sai zewai wai ge naso ego sena awa, “Nukare zanatiai nasora zo da di oko toyamunora.” Ago sena awa.
Otao mamai naso, nisokare nana zo nu Tuara ge azu toise tuma diai tepo kotumai waya puro Anutu putoure awa duai azu, dia ina-wa inoise noiwo.
Agoro nikare waiko be giti aumako aumako be itai gege itamunoya te soga ina-wa wewo. Wayara etetenai meni nisokare nana ena ema zo awita sai Tua doro deto-deto wanoya awa.
Isreli emara susu giro azu wanekai.
Nakai Kristora ge awa zaawero gita nu tuma dinakai, tuma diai awa ziro baititinoise puro noma betamunonakai, awa nakai Kristore dai nena ewa-gaewa pumamunonakai.
Ge gayai susura ena genakai awa noko ganekai, Anutu meni zeme ge nimorekare samunoya, awa eni meni deto-deto wewa ago ine oko wawe.
Awa arekare meni ge nuso niniro deto-deto weu? Awa zo ewe meni oko aewa. Mose meni gita wenu Izip zebura ena muwa, ema dubu awa dapikarago ami ago wewa awa.
Ata nukare na-amire Anutu meni ginu waya inoinu zepa 40 ago tepo wenu? Awa pasina inoise ware ena bebeteniwa numorekare ago wenua awa.
Agoro sai zewai wai ge ei awa na-amire senu? Nukare zanatiai nasora zo da di oko toyamunora. Awa ge nuso doinoise noisowa nukare amire senua awa.
Are ego gosinonakai awa: Nukare nu tuma kaka diamu wewa, are zanatiai nusora toyai ine tepo wewa.
